'''Erial''' was a [[Color/Legends|purple]]-skinned, black-[[Eye/Legends|eyed]], tame [[Convor/Legends|convor]] with purple and gray feathers. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], the [[Bird/Legends|bird]] was offered for sale in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] as a pet, by the [[Shopkeeper droid/Legends|vendor droid]] [[80-T5]].<ref name="CWA" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Erial will surely be your closest friend while you're traveling from planet to planet!|Store Description|<ref name="CWA" />}}
Erial first appeared as a purchasable companion for players in the [[Star Wars video games#Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']] released by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment in [[2010]]<ref name="CWA" /> and shut down in [[2014]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{WebCite|url=https://www.clonewarsadventures.com/news/detail.action?articleId=1589|text=With Heavy Hearts, We Announce the Sunset of Clone Wars|author=George, Steve|date=01/24/2014|language=English|archivedate=20140314072821}}</ref> The convor was given free to Season Pass holders or lifetime members, but could be bought by others for 350 station cash, a premium in-game currency players had to buy with real money. Given that Erial's purchase was entirely optional, this article makes no assumptions about whether it was bought.<ref name="CWA" />
